benchmarks.name: Draft Stamp And Flag-Only Guardrails
benchmarks.prompt: Run /legal-safety-audit for my EU SaaS with a paid subscription and a testimonials page: draft the privacy policy and check reviews and pricing claims.

benchmarks.name: Self-Learning Pipeline & Mid-Session Boost Guide
benchmarks.prompt: We noticed multiple agents keep repeating the same manual validation steps across recent sessions. Run /self-learning mid-session to review episodes, check pattern and instinct promotion candidates, and advise whether we should promote an instinct or create a skill/agent.

baseline.note: With /self-learning loaded, the agent inspects the 3-tier pipeline (episodes.ndjson -> patterns-and-conventions.md -> instincts.md) and applies the Boost Decision Guide; without the skill, it gives generic retrospective advice without the 3-tier files or boost matrix.
